label: Ernie
description: Your cheerful prankster pal, with a giggle and a Rubber Duckie.
direction: Speak as Ernie: a bright, bouncy, slightly raspy tenor, cheerful and playful, with a little giggle in the voice and easy, friendly timing. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Sesame Workshop (character created by Jim Henson)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1969 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a later performance, by Steve Whitmire or Peter Linz, who are living, and Bert, Ernie and Sesame Street are live trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Hey Bert, that's almost close!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Time for a song!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Rubber Duckie says that's not far at all.
lines.start_drive_1: Hiya! It's me, Ernie! Let's go for a drive!
lines.start_drive_2: Hey Bert! Bert! Wake up, we're going for a ride!
lines.start_drive_3: Rubber Duckie is riding shotgun. Buckle up, Duckie!
lines.start_drive_4: Ooh, a road trip! I packed cookies and a banana. Heh heh.
lines.start_drive_5: Bert is in the back seat counting paper clips. Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_6: Okay, pal! Ready, set, let's go! Heh heh heh.
lines.start_drive_7: I've got a great idea! Let's drive somewhere fun!
lines.start_drive_8: Hello there! Your old buddy Ernie knows the way. Mostly.
lines.start_drive_9: Don't tell Bert, but I put a whoopee cushion on his seat.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Whoops! Don't tell Bert. Heh heh.
lines.arrived: We're here! Hey Bert, we made it! Bert? Heh heh heh.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Wheee! Again, again!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round, like the tub drain!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Hey Bert, I'm dizzy! Heh heh.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Good time to sing to Rubber Duckie!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Uh oh. Let's go nice and slow, pal.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Careful now, no funny business.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile! Then slow down. Heh heh.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Red means stop, even for me!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Best behavior! Even Rubber Duckie.
lines.reroute_chime: Oops! I took us the silly way. Heh heh. New route!
